diagnosis: RefreshTokenIntrospectView allows retrieving active status, client ID, user identity, and scope details of any RefreshToken by token string. The lookup does not verify that the authenticated calling client matches the refresh token's registered application. A rogue client can probe refresh tokens across rival integrations to identify high-privilege persistent sessions.
